D/ [CONSTANTINUS AVE] ; R/ [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP]

Copper alloy. Coin: nummus.. Suggested date: Roman,Constantine I, 306-337. Diameter: 16.39mm, Weight: 1.35gms, die axis 11. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINUS AVE] Obverse design: Bareheaded bust facing Right. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP] Reverse design: Two victories resting shield on altar. Notes by MF kindly corrected by Cliff Reeves. Finder’s ref: SE 94451 17602
